questions: Should the sum of products be computed for all possible distinct pairs of numbers in the matrix, meaning each pair of distinct positions (i.e., combinations of indices), or for all possible distinct pairs of values (i.e., combinations of unique numbers regardless of position)?
If a number appears multiple times in the matrix, should each occurrence be considered a distinct element for pairing, or should duplicates be removed before generating pairs?
Should the pairs be ordered (i.e., permutations) or unordered (i.e., combinations)?
Is the sum of products computed as the sum of the product of each pair, or as the product of sums of pairs?
Should the function handle non-integer shapes (e.g., floats) or negative dimensions, and if so, how?
What should happen if the matrix has fewer than two elements? Should it return 0, raise an error, or something else?
Is the seed parameter used to seed the random number generator globally (np.random.seed) or locally (e.g., using a RandomState instance)?
